scenes.headline: Training a coding model to live inside a repository
scenes.sub: KAT-Coder-V2.5: AutoBuilder, a hint-free data flywheel, and a critic with hindsight.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Coral! KAT-Coder is trained to work inside real repositories, for dozens of turns. Here's the machine that trains it.

scenes.text: An autonomous coding agent is an environment-and-data problem before it is a modeling problem.
scenes.say: The idea: an autonomous coding agent is an environment-and-data problem before it's a modeling problem.

steps.say: Start from real repositories. An issue isn't a task, so a clean spec is regenerated from the merged patch and its tests.
AutoBuilder's build agent writes a setup script, and a separate agent verifies it in a sandbox, collecting over ninety percent of the tests.
That now works fifty-seven percent of the time, up from sixteen and a half, and yields over a hundred thousand environments in twelve languages.
Now the policy can practise: run the tests, edit files, and iterate for dozens of turns.

items.say: On hard tasks the pass rate is near zero. Process-level hints lift near-misses to about twenty percent.
Then replay the same tasks hint-free, and keep only what still recovers. No hint leaks into the data.
Score each trajectory's process, like minimal patches and honesty, not just whether the tests pass.
And vary the harness itself, so the policy learns the task, not one scaffold's quirks.

left.title: The actor
items: Sees only the normal harness state
left.say: In reinforcement learning, the actor sees only what it would see in deployment.

right.title: The hindsight critic
items: Also sees the final reward and tests
right.say: The critic also sees hindsight: the final reward, test outcomes, later turns. So its value estimates get far less noisy.

scenes.text: At long horizons, most of the win is in the plumbing: verifiable tasks, honest data, varied scaffolds, a critic with hindsight.

recap: Real repos rebuilt into 100K+ verifiable sandboxes
Hints recover near-misses, then get stripped out
A critic with hindsight steadies long-horizon RL
scenes.say: To recap: verifiable sandboxes, hint-free data, varied harnesses, and a critic that sees the future.
